title: Corporate Salary Voucher Offer - Offer Summary
text: Get Vouchers with benefits worth INR 3600. Availing maximum value benefit from all the offer categories brings the total value to the customer from this bundle of approximately INR 3600.

title: Corporate Salary Voucher Offer - Target Customers
text: The offer is valid for only a selected set of customers who receive the offer communication from HDFC Bank and customers who haven't received salary credit in their accounts.

title: Corporate Salary Voucher Offer - Eligible Organization Requirement
text: The salary should be credited from an organization/company that is part of the HDFC Bank's listed eligible companies. To check your company's eligibility and update your new employer details, click the link below.

title: Corporate Salary Voucher Offer - Voucher Delivery Timeline
text: The eligible customers will receive the vouchers within 60 days of the second salary credit. A customer must continuously receive a salary for 2 months to be eligible for these vouchers.

title: Corporate Salary Voucher Offer - Salary Account Type Requirement
text: To be eligible for the offer fulfilment, the customer must receive the salary in the Corporate Salary Account mapped to its customer ID only and not in any other type of account (Savings/Current).

title: Corporate Salary Voucher Offer - Visit Rewards Portal
text: Visit www.gyftr.com/rewards/hdfcbankinactivesalary/

title: Corporate Salary Voucher Offer - Enter Promo Code
text: Enter your Unique Promo Code.

title: Corporate Salary Voucher Offer - View Eligible Vouchers
text: You will be entering the Rewards Page, wherein you can see the list of all the Brand Vouchers you are eligible for.

title: Corporate Salary Voucher Offer - Click Redeem
text: Click on 'REDEEM'.

title: Corporate Salary Voucher Offer - Enter Personal Details
text: A summary pop-up will appear. Please enter your details – Name, Mobile Number and E-Mail Id. Click on 'GENERATE OTP'.

title: Corporate Salary Voucher Offer - Verify OTP
text: An OTP will be triggered to your Mobile Number, enter the same and click on 'SUBMIT'. The Gift Voucher of the chosen brand will instantly be sent to your Mobile Number and E-Mail Id.

title: Corporate Salary Voucher Offer - Promo Code Validity
text: The Unique Promo Code will be valid only for 30 days from the Date of Issuance. Eligible customers must claim their choice of the voucher within the expiry date mentioned on the eligibility E-Mail and SMS date.

title: Corporate Salary Voucher Offer - Brand Redemption Limit
text: Each customer can claim one brand only once out of the given choices. However, each customer can claim all the brands at least once out of the given choices.

title: Corporate Salary Voucher Offer - Gift Voucher Expiry
text: The Expiry Date of the Gift Vouchers claimed will be a minimum of 30 days from the date of claim. Please refer to the Voucher E-Mail and SMS for the exact date. Kindly use your Gift Voucher within the due date. Gift Vouchers, once expired, cannot be revalidated.

title: Corporate Salary Voucher Offer - Brand T&Cs Applicability
text: All respective T&Cs of the brands apply. Please visit the T&C section on the homepage for detailed Brand T&Cs.

title: Corporate Salary Voucher Offer - Total Bundle Value
text: Top Value of the Voucher Bundle: INR 3600. This is the cumulative value available to customers by availing benefits from all the offer categories.
